capabilities.purpose: Recover state, decisions, contracts, profiles and evidence.
Define a contract or template without coupling a consumer.
Define delta, affected surfaces, invariants, exclusions, compatibility, regression and rollback.
Inspect the Design System and decide whether to reuse, extend, create or keep an interface element local.
Model measurable quality scenarios, gates and evidence validity.
Model multidimensional operational exposure and progressive triggers.
Create a local candidate for code, schema, documentation or template.
Observe a candidate against applicable contracts.
Publish branch, main or release only with bound authority.
Observe use, cost and learning without confusing download with outcome.

selection_rule: Compose the smallest sufficient set for the Intent; model routing follows capability complexity and risk, never a permanent job title.
